# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow `/AGENTS.md` as the canonical coding guide for this repository. Before
editing native code, also read `/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`; before changing public
APIs, read `/docs/API.md`; and use `/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md` for validation.

Do not add object detection or YOLO, do not edit generated `lib/` output, and do
not claim TurboModule or physical-device support beyond what was verified.
